      @NotNull @NotNull List<Operation> rollback(boolean continueWhenFailed)
      Rolling back the transaction
      Parameters:
      continueWhenFailed - Continue when some parts of the rollback fails.
      Returns:
      A list contains all steps executed. If "continueWhenFailed" is false, it only contains all success steps before hit the error. Else all.
